description: This Kotlin source file contains utility functions related to image handling in an Android chat application. It includes functions for loading, decoding, scaling, and encoding images, as well as managing an in-memory cache for bitmap objects.

classes.name: LruCache<String, Bitmap>
classes.description: Custom cache implementation to store Bitmap objects mapped with String keys, with size calculated based on bitmap byte count.

methods.name: loadSizedImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads an image from a URI, scales it within specified constraints, compresses it to fit size limits, and encodes it in Base64 for chat attachments.

methods.name: decodeBase64Bitmap
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into a Bitmap object, utilizing caching and downsampling for efficient memory usage.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates an optimal sampling size for image scaling based on desired maximum dimension.

methods.name: normalizeAttachmentFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes and standardizes a filename string for image attachments, defaulting to 'image.jpg' if input is invalid.

methods.name: decodeScaledBitmap
methods.description: Decodes and scales an image from a URI, returning a Bitmap scaled to a maximum dimension.
